description: Pages losing organic clicks against the previous comparable period, with the likely cause (ranking loss, lower demand, cannibalization, CTR loss, technical indexing, outdated content) and the action. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
